goal: Ensure orphan transactions are retried when their announcer disconnects or is evicted
Prevents peers from deliberately stalling relay of fee-bumping child transactions like CPFP
reviewability: Serves as the base for PR #36506
agreement: Generally positive with no open objections

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it fixes an exploitable relay liveness hole where reconsiderations are dropped on disconnect
Malicious peers can otherwise stall CPFP child relay until the stranded orphan is evicted

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it adds an end-to-end fuzz target testing 1-parent-1-child relay under adversarial conditions
Proves high bug-finding value by reproducing the orphan stall on master in under an hour
